sentence: This project looks for simpler ways to create mathematical networks that interconnect many points, and for uses of them in quantum computing.
This project builds a way to put dopants into semiconductor crystals that have already grown, with nanometer-scale control.
This project develops computer vision methods that learn from a large number of unlabeled images of animals.
This project builds an artificial intelligence platform that helps design mRNA drugs and vaccines before any laboratory work begins.
This project studies how molecules that absorb light move their atoms, and tries to control those changes with intense laser pulses.
This project studies hard computational problems from algebra that are linked to cryptography, coding theory and quantum computing.
This project tries to find out which genes control skin color and color patterns in three species of poison frogs.
This project develops algorithms that let modular robots change their shape, using more realistic models.
This project tests how research institutions can put cybersecurity controls in place, and shares what it learns about the challenges.
This project builds a way for robots to learn complex tasks from a few demonstrations that combine vision with language.
This project studies how changes in precipitation affect the way water enters the atmosphere through plants, soil and wet plant surfaces.
This project builds deep learning methods that run on many separate devices, keep working when communication fails, and adapt to changing conditions.
This project builds genetic tools for a filamentous cyanobacterium so researchers can better understand its biology and how its genes shape its traits.
This project works with school communities to design food gardens that help children's health and teach about climate change.
This project studies how the way monitoring programs are designed changes what scientists learn about population trends, and builds software to help design them.
This project builds a social robot that watches engineering teams, detects inequities and steps in during meetings to make teams more equitable.
